correctness.rationale: The n-2 toric maximal components with ordered partition {1}|{2..b+1}|{b+2..n} restrict each Pluecker coordinate to 0 or a signed monomial t_i t_j. Z^n-degree separates quadratic weights. Two-index weights restrict nontrivially, three-index weights vanish exactly when the repeated index is the middle b>=2, and four-index weights have one Pluecker kernel relation if index 1 occurs and an additional disjoint-index kernel when not. This proves the direct sum and dim(I_n)_2=2*C(n,4) in every n>=4. Independent exact-rational restriction-rank computation for n=4..9 returned 2,10,30,70,140,252 respectively, corroborating but not replacing the general weight split.
